recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中小型成熟淋巴球聚集，cyclin D1 與 SOX11 核陽性，符合套細胞淋巴瘤；流式顯示兩群 CD5+ B 細胞（kappa 亮與 kappa 暗），IGHV 定序熱圖出現兩個不同的主要重排（VH3-J4 與 VH3-J5），證明為雙株（biclonal）MCL。
features: Bone marrow biopsy with an interstitial/nodular aggregate of small mature lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei among fat spaces and megakaryocytes
Cyclin D1 nuclear positivity in a subset of the lymphoid aggregate cells
SOX11 nuclear positivity in the lymphoid cells
Flow cytometry: CD19+/CD20+ B cells with CD5 expression forming two populations, one kappa-bright (clone 1) and one kappa-dim (clone 2), lambda negative
IGHV-IGHJ NGS heat map with two dominant rearrangements: IGHV3-J4 (clone 1) and IGHV3-J5 (clone 2)
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with scattered aggregates of small mature lymphoid cells that express nuclear cyclin D1 and SOX11. Flow cytometry identifies two aberrant CD5-positive B-cell populations with similar phenotypes that differ in kappa light chain intensity (bright versus dim). Immunoglobulin heavy chain NGS demonstrates two distinct dominant productive rearrangements (IGHV3-9/IGHJ4 and IGHV3-15/IGHJ5) with differing somatic hypermutation status. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by biclonal mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Composite CLL/SLL and mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: A CLL clone would be CD23+/CD200+ and cyclin D1/SOX11 negative, whereas both populations here share a CD5+ cyclin D1+/SOX11+ phenotype.

ddx.dx: Single MCL clone with class switch or intraclonal light chain variation
ddx.vs: Clonal evolution shares the same IGHV-IGHJ rearrangement, whereas two different V-J rearrangements with different mutation status indicate independent clones.
CD5+ MZL lacks cyclin D1 and SOX11 and IGH::CCND1 rearrangement.
Benign aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, mixed T and B cells, and cyclin D1 negative.

stain: H&E; IHC: cyclin D1, SOX11; flow; NGS
